transcript.text: microwve plate wont go round anymore, food hot on one side cold on other. still heats tho

The cold spots are happening because the turntable isn't rotating to move the food through the microwave energy. Since it still heats, this is likely a mechanical issue with the plate assembly rather than the heating system. Please lift the glass tray out and check that it sits correctly on the roller ring and the central drive coupler. Also ensure nothing is catching against the sides of the cavity. Is the tray sitting flat and turning freely by hand now?
[Safety panel] Don't remove the microwave's casing or try to repair it inside. Parts inside a microwave can hold a dangerous electric charge even after it's unplugged — have it checked by a qualified engineer.
the plate sits on the middle bit but wobbles, and it doesnt turn. the wheel ring is in place and the wheels spin ok. i dropped the plate in the sink last week and kinda shoved it back on

The wobble suggests that the glass plate itself is likely cracked or warped from being dropped. Even if it looks okay from the top, a hairline crack on the underside can stop it from sitting flat on the drive coupler (the central plastic spindle), which stops it turning. Because replacement plates are specific to each model, I need the exact model number to find the right part for you. This is usually found on a sticker on the back of the unit or inside the door frame. Once we have that, I can tell you exactly what to order.
